rows: Registration and coffee; starter code opens. Pages and participant guide are already available. Environment checks only until 11:00.
Welcome and AI Nation introduction (Juliana Carneiro da Cunha Baumgartl, about 5 minutes).
Challenge brief by Hula Earth and Ames (maximum 10 minutes each), including the datasets.
Team formation, challenge/category confirmation and mentor introductions.
Hackathon modeling and analysis begin. Teams raise a hand for mentor help.
Lunch in the room; no fixed work break.
Test-key release on the Space; decrypt preloaded inputs and begin final inference/submissions.
Mentor round: every team gets a check-in, including data loading, inference and submission questions.
Feature-freeze checkpoint and second mentor round; focus on final inference, figures, slides and delivery.
Deadline for predictions, nomination, method/code reference and presentation PDF.
